title: Ladder 18 · Ambulāns cōgitō (the participle pyramid)
summary: A pyramid in the style of Ladder 5, on 5 sentences only: Ambulāns cōgitō · Tē lentē loquentem intellegō · Verbum ā tē dictum nōn intellegō · Tē loquente, taceō · Lēctiōne fīnītā, ambulō. Slow steps, plain → new pairs, reviews, one day with your teacher, your son and your wife, and all five again at the end. English → Latin, then the Latin twice. Iulia's voice.
